description: Infrastructure-level monitoring configuration for metrics, dashboards, alerting, logging backends, and SLO/SLI policy. Use when asked to set up monitoring, create a Grafana dashboard, write Prometheus alerting rules, define SLOs, configure Alertmanager routing, set up centralized logging with Loki or Elasticsearch, configure tracing backends such as Jaeger or Tempo, or write an on-call runbook.
